```{r}
data <- coping_data <- data.frame(
  Class = factor(c("Secure-adjusted", "Ambivalent-strained", "Disorganised-adversity")),
  Mean = c(18.296, 15.085, 14.780),
  SE = c(0.324, 0.342, 0.973)
)
data
```


```{r}
# Step 2: Load ggplot2
library(ggplot2)

# Step 3: Plot barplot with error bars
ggplot(data, aes(x = Class, y = Mean)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 0.6, color = "black") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = Mean - SE, ymax = Mean + SE), width = 0.2) +
  labs(title = "Positive Coping by Class",
       y = "Positive Coping Score",
       x = "Latent Class") +
  theme_minimal()

```

```{r}
colnames(df) <- c("Fcare", "Fencour", "Fcontrol",
                  "Mcare", "Mencour", "Mcontrol",
                  "Emoabus", "Phyabus", "Sexabus",
                  "Emoneg", "Phyneg",
                  "PCoping", "NCoping",
                  "prob_c1", "prob_c2", "prob_c3",
                  "Class")

# Convert Class to factor
df$Class <- factor(df$Class)

```

```{r}
# Boxplot for Positive Coping
boxplot(PCoping ~ Class, data = df,
        main = "Positive Coping by Latent Class",
        xlab = "Latent Class", ylab = "Positive Coping",
        col = c("skyblue", "lightgreen", "salmon"),
        outline = FALSE,  # Disable outlier dots
        names = c("Ambivalent-strained", "Secure-adjusted", "Disorganised-adversity"))

```
```{r}

# Boxplot for Negative Coping
boxplot(NCoping ~ Class, data = df,
        main = "Negative Coping by Latent Class",
        xlab = "Latent Class", ylab = "Negative Coping",
        col = c("skyblue", "lightgreen", "salmon"))

```
```{r}
# Boxplot for Positive Coping with participant dots
boxplot(PCoping ~ Class, data = df,
        main = "Positive Coping by Latent Class",
        xlab = "Latent Class", ylab = "Positive Coping",
        col = c("skyblue", "lightgreen", "salmon"),
        outline = FALSE)  # Disable outlier dots

```


```{r}
# Boxplot for Negative Coping with participant dots
boxplot(NCoping ~ Class, data = df,
        main = "Negative Coping by Latent Class",
        xlab = "Latent Class", ylab = "Negative Coping",
        col = c("skyblue", "lightgreen", "salmon"),
        outline = FALSE)  # Disable outlier dots

# Add the individual participant dots
points(jitter(rep(1:nrow(df), length = nrow(df))), 
       df$NCoping, 
       col = "black", 
       pch = 16,  # Solid circle
       cex = 0.7)  # Size of the dots

```
```{r}
# Data for the plot (Means and Standard Errors)
coping_strategy <- c("Positive Coping", "Negative Coping")
secure_adjusted_means <- c(18.30, 11.13)
secure_adjusted_se <- c(0.32, 0.20)

ambivalent_strained_means <- c(15.09, 11.50)
ambivalent_strained_se <- c(0.34, 0.23)

high_risk_adversity_means <- c(14.78, 13.98)
high_risk_adversity_se <- c(0.97, 0.58)

# Create a data frame for plotting
df <- data.frame(
  Strategy = rep(coping_strategy, each = 3),
  Group = rep(c("Secure-adjusted", "Ambivalent-strained", "High-risk adversity"), times = 2),
  Mean = c(secure_adjusted_means, ambivalent_strained_means, high_risk_adversity_means),
  SE = c(secure_adjusted_se, ambivalent_strained_se, high_risk_adversity_se)
)

# Load necessary libraries
library(ggplot2)
```


```{r}
# Create the bar plot with error bars
ggplot(df, aes(x = Strategy, y = Mean, fill = Group, group = Group)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge", color = "black", width = 0.7) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = Mean - SE, ymax = Mean + SE), position = position_dodge(0.7), width = 0.25) +
  labs(x = "Coping Strategy", y = "Mean Score", title = "Coping Strategies by Group") +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("skyblue", "lightgreen", "salmon"))


```
```{r}
# Create a data frame for plotting
data <- data.frame(
  CopingStrategy = rep(c("Positive Coping", "Negative Coping"), each = 3),
  MeanScore = c(18.30, 15.09, 14.78, 11.13, 11.50, 13.98),  # Means for each coping strategy
  SE = c(0.32, 0.34, 0.97, 0.20, 0.23, 0.58),  # Standard errors for each coping strategy
  Group = rep(c("Secure-adjusted", "Ambivalent-strained", "High-risk adversity"), 2)
)

# Factor levels to ensure bars appear in the correct order
data$Group <- factor(data$Group, levels = c("Secure-adjusted", "Ambivalent-strained", "High-risk adversity"))

# Plot the bar chart with error bars
library(ggplot2)
ggplot(data, aes(x = CopingStrategy, y = MeanScore, fill = Group, group = Group)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.7) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = MeanScore - SE, ymax = MeanScore + SE), 
                position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.25) +
  labs(title = "Coping Strategies by Group", y = "Mean Score", x = "Coping Strategy") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("skyblue", "lightgreen", "salmon")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.line = element_line(size = 1), # Thicker axis lines
        axis.ticks = element_line(size = 1), # Thicker axis ticks
        panel.grid = element_blank()) # Remove grid lines

```

```{r}
# Create a data frame for plotting
data <- data.frame(
  CopingStrategy = rep(c("Positive Coping", "Negative Coping"), each = 3),
  MeanScore = c(18.30, 15.09, 14.78, 11.13, 11.50, 13.98),  # Means for each coping strategy
  SE = c(0.32, 0.34, 0.97, 0.20, 0.23, 0.58),  # Standard errors for each coping strategy
  Profiles = rep(c("Secure-adjusted", "Ambivalent-strained", "High-risk adversity"), 2)
)

# Factor levels to ensure bars appear in the correct order
data$Profiles <- factor(data$Profiles, levels = c("Secure-adjusted", "Ambivalent-strained", "High-risk adversity"))

# Plot the bar chart with error bars
library(ggplot2)
ggplot(data, aes(x = CopingStrategy, y = MeanScore, fill = Profiles, group = Profiles)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.7, color = "black") +  # Add border line
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = MeanScore - SE, ymax = MeanScore + SE), 
                position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.25) +
  labs( y = "Mean Score", x = "Coping Strategies") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("skyblue", "lightgreen", "salmon")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.line = element_line(size = 0.5), # Thicker axis lines
        axis.ticks = element_line(size = 0.5), # Thicker axis ticks
        panel.grid = element_blank(),   
        text = element_text(family = "Times New Roman"),# Remove grid lines
        plot.margin = unit(c(1, 1, 1, 1), "cm")) + # Adjust margins
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0), limits = c(0, 20))# Remove space between chart area and x-axis

```
